question: Do speaker tag prompts get seen, played and answered, and how often do people turn off saving other people's voices, per namespace/build? Recognition quality itself is measured server-side from answer outcomes (omi_speaker_tag_prompt_quality_total), not from these presence counts.
zero_policy: Zero views can mean no eligible clips in the last 48 hours; read the server's omi_speaker_tag_prompt_requests_total status before calling the card broken.
